name: Bin Chen
summary: The Cosmic Jester himself. Broke, snarky, surprisingly tactical. Charisma is his weapon. Trains as Warrior (sword) or Thief (dagger).

name: Peri
summary: Bin's CJS narrator-companion. Speaks in stage directions. Tags her own jokes for the system to log.

name: Bowy
summary: Half-orc/half-boar marksman. Gruff, loyal. His crossbow Thunder is his pride. Trains as Archer (bow) or Thief (dagger).

name: Garr
summary: Veteran hunter, adoptive father. Holds a secret from Peri. Steady and reliable.

name: Mitia
summary: Shy and kind. Secret Fae heritage. The emotional heart of the group. Ice magic.

name: Burnice
summary: Rooftop scout and burn-lane specialist. Burnice uses flare bolts, scavenged accelerant, and practiced route discipline to keep the horde…
